records.applicationTiming: Starter band at planting; remaining N pre-plant or side-dressed at V4-V6.
records.applicationMethod: Apply a starter band (2x2) of 30-40 lb N/acre with full P and K at planting. Pre-plant or side-dress the remaining N at V4-V6 stage following the MRTN (Maximum Return to Nitrogen) approach for the 180-220 bu/acre grain target.
records.notes: N 140-180 lb/acre; P2O5 55-75 lb/acre; K2O 60-85 lb/acre (converted to kg/ha ×1.12085). Target: 180-220 bu/acre grain.

records.applicationMethod: No nitrogen needed — biological N-fixation via Bradyrhizobium. Apply P2O5 and K2O pre-plant incorporated, or fall-applied before tillage.

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K + starter N at planting; N top-dressed at spring green-up.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and K2O plus 20-30 lb N/acre at planting. Top-dress the remaining N in spring at green-up (Feekes 4-5).
records.notes: N 70-100 lb/acre; P2O5 40-50; K2O 30-40 lb/acre (×1.12085). Winter/spring wheat.

records.micronutrients: MgSO4 10 kg/ha + Borax 2 kg/ha (foliar or basal) to prevent leaf reddening and square drop.
records.applicationTiming: 1/3 N + all P/K at planting; N side-dressed at first square to early bloom.
records.applicationMethod: Apply 1/3 of N plus all P2O5 and K2O at planting. Side-dress the remaining N at first square to early bloom.
records.notes: N 60-90 lb/acre; P2O5 35-50; K2O 40-60 lb/acre (×1.12085). Upland irrigated.

records.applicationTiming: Full P/K pre-plant; N pre-flood or split pre-flood + mid-season.
records.applicationMethod: Apply full P2O5 and K2O pre-plant. Apply N as a single pre-flood application or a 2-way split (pre-flood + mid-season).
records.notes: N 110-145 lb/acre; P2O5 40-60; K2O 50-75 lb/acre (×1.12085). Drill-seeded Mid-South rice.

records.applicationTiming: All P/K at planting; N 50% pre-plant + 50% side-dress at 30 days.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and K2O at planting. Split N: 50% pre-plant, 50% side-dressed at ~30 days post-emergence.
records.notes: N 70-95 lb/acre; P2O5 30-40; K2O 30-45 lb/acre (×1.12085). Grain sorghum.

records.applicationTiming: Full P/K at seeding; N pre-plant or at tillering.
records.applicationMethod: Apply full P2O5 and K2O at seeding. Incorporate N pre-plant or apply at tillering. Keep N on the lower end for malting barley to prevent high grain protein.
records.notes: N 50-75 lb/acre; P2O5 30-45; K2O 25-40 lb/acre (×1.12085). Malting barley: cap N lower for grain protein.

records.applicationTiming: Entire dose pre-plant incorporated or drilled with seed.
records.applicationMethod: Apply the entire fertilizer dose pre-plant incorporated or drilled with the seed.

records.applicationTiming: Broadcast + incorporate pre-plant, or band 2 inches from seed.
records.applicationMethod: Broadcast and incorporate pre-plant; alternatively band-place fertilizer 2 inches away from seeds.

records.micronutrients: SOP (sulfate of potash) preferred as K source for processing quality.
records.applicationTiming: 1/3 N + full P + 1/2 K banded at planting; rest fertigated through bulking.
records.applicationMethod: Band at planting: 1/3 of N, full P2O5, 1/2 of K2O. Fertigate the remaining N and K in splits through tuber bulking.
records.notes: N 180-240 lb/acre; P2O5 120-180; K2O 180-260 lb/acre (×1.12085). Russet Burbank/processing.

records.applicationTiming: Broadcast + incorporated prior to spring seeding.
records.applicationMethod: Broadcast and incorporate prior to spring seeding. Avoid excess N late in the season to maintain sucrose purity.
records.notes: N 90-120 lb/acre; P2O5 50-70; K2O 40-60 lb/acre (×1.12085). Limit late-season N for sucrose purity.

records.applicationTiming: Top-dressed early spring or after 1st/2nd cutting (per year).
records.applicationMethod: No N needed (N-fixing legume). Top-dress P2O5 and K2O in early spring or immediately after the 1st/2nd cutting. Alfalfa is a heavy potassium feeder — do not under-apply K.
records.notes: N 0 (N-fixing); P2O5 45-65; K2O 140-200 lb/acre/year (×1.12085). Established stands.
